exceptions.reason: Existing FTP-management compatibility probe: admin-only POST /api/v1/ftp/test explicitly authenticates to an operator-selected legacy FTP server. FTP credentials are unencrypted; this remains a known protocol limitation, not a safe general-purpose transport. Acceptance is limited to this unchanged function; migrate the probe to explicit FTPS/SFTP support before retiring it.
